description: Colombia's RUPS lists providers of drinking water, sewerage, waste, electricity and gas services with identifying attributes. Coverage is Colombia, with one registry entry per utility provider; observation dates and completeness vary and were not checked against data rows. The provider landing page describes access to API JSON material. Licence: CC-BY-SA-4.0.
